errors.text_span: показва равномерно разпределени години от 2010 до 2021, с интервали от две години
errors.evidence: The description states that the years on the x-axis are evenly distributed with two-year intervals, but the last interval, between 2020 and 2021, is only one year.
The description incorrectly identifies the legend label "Регистрации" (Registrations) as a marker on the line. The line plot does not have any point markers.
The line starts at a value slightly above 0 million in 2010 (approximately 0.1 million), not exactly at 0.
